description: This file defines an API for subscribing to and handling notifications about changes to the current working directory. It includes function declarations for registering, unregistering, and triggering notifications, as well as for reparenting relative paths.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Registers a callback to be notified when the working directory changes.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Changes the current working directory and notifies registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Reparents a relative path from one root to another, possibly returning an absolute path.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
